|printed_lore=''<span lang="ja">ローディアン男性のバウンティ・ハンター。ジャバの使いでハンを捕えに来た。横柄で自信過剰な態度から、頭の弱さも見てとれる。賞金稼ぎを師事したディズ・ナタズやスパーチ・ゴアからも裏切られ、同族スークーに売り渡されていた。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
|translation='''Title:''' Greedo.

'''Card text:'''
During the opponent's control phase, you may choose one smuggler at the same location and “threaten” them. If the opponent uses all Force in the Force Deck, this effect is canceled and you immediately activate the same amount of Force. Otherwise, draw destiny. If destiny + Greedo's ability > 6, the smuggler is lost.

'''Lore:'''
A male Rodian bounty hunter. He came on Jabba's errand to capture Han. His arrogant, overconfident manner also shows a weak mind. Betrayed by the bounty hunters he trained under, Diz Nataz and Spurch Goa, he had been sold to his fellow Thuku.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese uses フォース・デッキ for Force Pile.
